Caution and monitoring are advised due to additive anticholinergic effects and the potential for hypoglycemia. 2. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 3. Both hyoscyamine and maprotiline reduce cholinergic effects or transmission. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 4. Hyoscyamine increases the toxicity of oliceridine, potentially leading to urinary retention and/or severe constipation, which may result in paralytic ileus. Caution and monitoring are advised. 13.
